_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: System Flights/Readiness Status Information Report
summary: The System Flights/Readiness Status Information Report is used to report status and activities of target operations, assess readiness of targets materiel, record maintenance activities and problems, and document actions and recommendations.
description_purpose:
3.1 The System Flights/Readiness Status Information Report is used for reporting status and activities of target operations.
3.2 The report assesses the readiness of targets materiel in use; establishes a record of maintenance activities and problems identified along with solutions; and documents actions pending and recommendations made.
application_interrelationship: 7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The System Flights/Readiness Status Information Report format shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format arrangement shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The System Flights/Readiness Status Information Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Effort expended in support of test operations.

Quality control information on frequency and type of problems associated with major items and repair parts of system equipment; unresolved problems along with recommendation for remedial action; items of special interest based on quality audits, surveys, investigations, and visits.
Identity of targets (serial number, location, and condition status).
Target engine run-ups and maintenance repair actions by target and engine serial number.

Copies of Target Tracking and Control System (TTCS) weekly, monthly, and quarterly operational preventive maintenance checks performed in accordance with applicable documentation (i.e., technical manuals, standard operating procedures, etc.).
All preventive and corrective repair actions on TTCS and associated peculiar test equipment.
Equipment Identification (TTCS, digital code generator, etc.) and serial number.
System elapsed time meter reading and subsystem meter reading.
Date of failure.
Nomenclature of assembly, sub-assembly, to component failure item.
Failure circumstances (i.e., bench check, pre-flight, launch, flight, weekly, monthly, and quarterly checks).
Description of failure with cause analysis.
Time required to troubleshoot.
Repair action.
Time required to repair.
Equipment downtime.
Improvement recommendations.
Hardware.
Publications and procedures.
Inspection, condition, and repairs to target associated ground support equipment, including tools and test equipment.
Unusual events and activities (security, weather, excessive corrosion, mold, mildew, etc.).
Problems encountered and recommended solutions.
Lists of official visitors to contractor and subcontractor facilities, indicating purpose and duration of visit.
Lists of significant technical memoranda, plans, reports, or other material describing contract efforts.

Lists of significant decisions, material, etc., requested by the Government which are pending; significant requests placed on the contractor by the Government which are pending with status and expected reply date.
Lists of requirement computations completed, results, order placement dates, priority of need, and current status.
Identification of stock shortage items with projected zero balance dates.
Lists of summary flight services data pertaining to flights occurring during the reporting period as follows:
Target configuration and augmentation.
Time of launch.
Flight number.
Data.
Target serial number.
Number of presentations.
Flight altitude.
Flight profile.
Flight time.
Target retrieval.
Target condition.
Number of previous flights on the target recovery system.
Flight rating (satisfactory or unsatisfactory).
Target loss (kill, operational loss).
children.content: Explanation for loss and remarks concerning target operations.

children.title: Operational loss rate and satisfactory flight rate total percentages for the reporting month, each quarter and at the end of each fiscal year of the contract.
Remaining flights available for the fiscal year for each target system.
Problems encountered, recommended solutions, and uneventful circumstances, such as weather, performance, terrain, etc.
